remarks: Welcome home to this light filled 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath Colonial located in one of Darien's most sought after neighborhoods. First floor consists of living room with fireplace, dining room with bay window, wet bar, and wine fridge. The large eat-in kitchen opens up to oversized family room overlooking patio and landscaped yard perfect for today's open floor plan living. Private office/den attaches to kitchen. Upstairs boasts four bedrooms. Primary bedroom has cathedral ceilings with two large walk in closets and fully appointed bath. Finished basement has additional 728 sq.ft with playroom and small additional room perfect for additional office or gym, storage room, utility room, and tons of closets for extra storage. Detached two car garage comes equipped with electric charger. Ideal location close to schools, beaches, train, Great Island, Darien Commons, and downtown.
